benchmark_decision: Lead with a recognisable getting-dressed moment; let the reader question fixed capsule rules; move from their own repeat choices to complete outfits and a small practical method; close with a decision about what, if anything, to add. Make the prose more reader-facing and conversational through natural questions, direct address and gentle asides. Keep Cottonworld’s calm, warm, life-first voice; do not imitate first-person anecdotes, fixed staple lists, seasonal framing or affiliate-heavy product blocks.
